rows: Main armament A variety of light and medium caliber weapons, AGLs , or ATGMs can be fitted

silhouette_requirements: Two axles/four wheels; large tires; short sloped hood; armored angular cab; four doors; roof protected HMG station; compact rear cargo.
reference_limits: Nominal JLTV family dimensions; use M1278 heavy-guns-carrier roof hardware references, not M-ATV.
frame_evidence: Envelope derived from cited family references where present. Mount/eye frames are approximate delegated authoring choices, NOT factory measurements; coordinator adopts matching physical rows before dispatch. Worker must never change frames unilaterally.

frame_correction.reason: Preserve adopted body envelope; reauthor genuine taller hull/cab and hatches/periscopes rather than lower physics to prior candidate. Independent exact-variant photos show station clearly above roof. Chosen approximate station bore above authored nominal deck: Stryker ICV/RV0.65m, M1134launcher0.55m, JLTVHGC0.45m. Eye chosen near station optic. These are physical authoring decisions, not factory measurements.
frame_correction.body_measurement: Published family body height retained by coordinator; bare roof versus total armed source semantics unresolved. Geometry deliberately approximate within adopted gameplay envelope, no filler.
frame_correction.mount_measurement: Photo-relative estimate; approximately +/-0.15m due to perspective and suspension state. Stryker_ICV_front_q, Stryker_RV_front_q, Stryker_M1134_ATGM and M1278HGC independent photographs, pinned production_photo_receipts.
frame_correction.additional_evidence: AM General JLTV-A2 brochure explicitly adjustable-height suspension; MotorTrend reports transport setting can match Humvee74in roof. These prove state dependence, not an M1278 normal-height bare roof numeric. A2 brochure is family-suspension corroboration, not exact M1278 dimension proof.

tire_scale_audit.manufacturer_dimensions: XZL365/85R20 unloaded OD1144mm; XZL395/85R20 unloaded OD46.8in=1188.72mm. Neither establishes actual M1278 fitted size. Loaded tire shape/suspension state/perspective add uncertainty.
tire_scale_audit.photo_scale: 1920px photo front tire vertical392px, cab-ground844px; rear tire328px, cab-ground710px. Ratios2.153/2.165 imply rough cab2.46–2.48m for365 or2.56–2.57m for395, subject to loaded diameter/perspective. This does not support blindly lowering body to candidate cab2.23m.
tire_scale_audit.limit: Candidate tire radii are authored approximations, not source scale. No tire fit identification was obtained; Commons follow-up imagery unavailable (403).
